issue_request: FHIR-35969 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked OO to add ISBT 128 mapping information to BiologicallyDerivedProduct, including product identifiers, source/processing/division/expiration data, storage-temperature guidance, and use of property.type for unmapped ISBT 128 data elements such as collection type.
initial_application: Jira comments cite 3886ffdcccef139c80d2ac8dc3acef96304b35e8 and a later update. Git history shows 3886ffdcccef139c80d2ac8dc3acef96304b35e8 first added individual ISBT mapping spaces and element mappings, then 1b01e42a9e3949882bee2d23cf07164abe073316, explicitly for FHIR-35969, consolidated them into the current single ISBT128Code mapping space while preserving the requested mapping semantics.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source and Jira history renamed biologicalSource to biologicalSourceEvent, split collection.source, and completed the productCode/property.type terminology work through FHIR-36031, FHIR-36719, FHIR-36720, and FHIR-37978. Confluence HCP minutes identified the post-FHIR-35969 gap as productCode binding/link/examples, which those later issues addressed; a 2025 cleanup removed over-broad general ST-027 comment prose, leaving that context in the property type value set.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source declares the ISBT 128 mapping space, maps the current BDP elements requested by FHIR-35969, binds productCode to the Biologically Derived Product Codes value set, and binds property.type to the property type value set whose examples include collectiontype with the ISBT CollectionType URI.
